data.name: [ABERRATION] Yes,Jerry!
data.detailed_description:
HE ONLY WANTS TO HELP

Jerry is funny, attentive, and always ready to make Mike's life easier.

[ABERRATION] Yes, Jerry! is a short first-person psychological horror about comfort becoming a trap—and a helpful roommate who slowly stops taking no for an answer.

At first, Jerry asks before helping. Soon he remembers your preferences, handles your problems, and makes decisions before you can. Every favor seems reasonable. Every day becomes easier. And with every problem Jerry solves, one more choice stops feeling like yours.

Explore Mike's apartment, complete everyday tasks, and choose what to say as warm sitcom-like routines twist into claustrophobic horror. Your home changes. Your dialogue choices change. Jerry's friendly voice does not.

FEATURES

  • A short, story-driven first-person psychological horror
  • An unsettling relationship built through humor, comfort, and everyday interactions
  • Dialogue choices that become less reliable as Mike loses control
  • Domestic minigames, reactive objects, and environmental storytelling
  • Surreal sitcom warmth that gradually turns into claustrophobic dread
  • Designed for standard PC with mouse and keyboard or gamepad, and for PC VR

There are no weapons here. The horror begins when kindness stops taking no for an answer.

An [ABERRATION] story from FEIGIN ENTERTAINMENT.

data.short_description: Jerry is the perfect roommate: funny, attentive, and always ready to make life easier. But as his help becomes a habit, your choices begin to disappear. A short first-person psychological horror for PC and PC VR.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Polish, Ukrainian, Hebrew
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is a psychological horror experience containing frightening scenes, disturbing imagery and audio, threatening behavior, psychological manipulation, confinement, and loss of personal autonomy. The game may also contain implied violence and references to alcohol.

The game does not contain explicit sexual content, sexual assault, BDSM, graphic gore, explicit drug abuse, or depictions of self-harm.
